description: Sort text into your own labels (support ticket routing, intent, topic, spam, lead quality) or, with no labels, get its sentiment (positive, negative, neutral). Returns the best label, a confidence and a one-line reason. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

labels.description: Your labels, e.g. ["billing", "bug", "feature request", "other"]. Default: sentiment.

multi.description: Allow more than one label. Default false.

name: classify_text
title: Classify text and sentiment
